definitions.gloss: directly under; direct subordination; reporting directly to
definitions.explanation: Being under the direct authority or supervision of someone without any intermediate level. Commonly used for organizational relationships in workplaces and military.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{直属|ちょくぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a team that reports directly to the president.

examples.japanese: {直属|ちょくぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll consult with my direct supervisor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本部長|ほんぶちょう}{直属|ちょくぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: As a direct subordinate of the division head, he has been entrusted with important projects.

notes:
Compound of {直|ちょく} (direct) + {属|ぞく} (belong to). Used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective to modify nouns describing organizational relationships.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直属|ちょくぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧ — direct supervisor/boss
- {直属|ちょくぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧ — direct subordinate
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{直属|ちょくぞく} — reporting directly to the president
- {直属|ちょくぞく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be under the direct authority of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧ — belonging to, affiliation (does not imply direct reporting)
- ⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧ — assignment, posting (being assigned to a department)
